name: Skyblock QoL: Mining & Dungeons
description: Unofficial Minecraft 1.21 Fabric port focused on Mining and Dungeon features. Includes a dedicated in-game settings GUI, Mining trackers with separate Powder/Pristine per-gem quality breakdowns, adjustable Gold Tracker units and rates, and filters, Fetchur, HOTM tooltip, Commission Highlight, Pickobulus Preview, Ghost Tracker, Dungeon timers and split tracking, boss/Blood highlights, cached Dungeon data, rectangular room detection, secret markers, an adjustable Dungeon map, and a clickable Spirit Leap/InfiniLeap menu.
